mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired skin segment was most worthwhile: the scar stayed in its original place and its vessels and nerves connected to the surrounding skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the eye and ears felt fairly predictable, especially when the ears were the only combination left.

surprise.text: The digestive tract result made the distinction clear: food stays inside the tube while absorbed material crosses its lining.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals showed where the parts belonged. The compatible options also supplied the pairings, so I wasn't discovering them independently.

continue.text: I might continue to see how more body systems connect, though this chapter felt more like predictable assembly than a challenge.
